regime_context: The detector shows a defensive HAVEN/relative-strength regime centered on US healthcare and defensive sectors: Big Pharma, equal-weight Healthcare, and Defensives/Staples are the only eligible themes with strong durability bars (0.78–0.84) and full/near-full breadth, while high-beta AI/semi/crypto themes sit deeply ineligible at the bottom of the rank list. The gate_helps flag is TRUE on this market's history, so the trend discipline does cut drawdown even though momentum rank itself has no alpha. Track record (dir_accuracy 0.413 on n=138) is materially worse than a coin flip for direction; high-conviction calls should be avoided.
emerging_watch: AI theme leadership appears to be broadly breaking down (AI Semis, AI Infra, AI Software, AI Neoclouds all ineligible and at the bottom of ranks while defensive/health themes rise). Watching for a CONFIRMED end-of-trend signal: if SMH posts a 52-week closing high BEFORE the next 20 trading days while healthcare remains eligible, the defensive-to-AI handoff hypothesis is retired — otherwise stay defensive.

theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the headline leader with the highest eligible durability bar (0.84), full breadth (1.0), and 'confirming' valuation state — the most coherent trend-health profile in the ranked universe. Crowding is elevated (crowded true, z=1.5), but per guardrails this is a size-down caution, not a fade; the absolute-trend gate is validated on this market, so staying with the strongest eligible trend is defensible.
evidence: eligible=true, durability_bar=0.84 (highest among eligible themes), hurst=trend

rotation leader Big Pharma with challenger margin over memory (0.76) and absorption low at 0.32
